title: Raincheck regression doodle — Bex
content:
Purpose
- Quick scratchpad for odd regression snapshots from nightly run (11/02 seeds). Save hypotheses before they evaporate.
- Short aim: capture 6 representative failures, attach ad-hoc rubric, sketch first-pass mitigations.

Context / background
- Running seed batch against hosted-model-x: v1.9 (baseline) -> v2.1 (recent change: kv-cache rewrite + kernel fallback). Observatory flagged 12% increase in content hallucinations for task: "summarize-policy" (long-context, 1.2k tokens).
- Metric hits: fidelity_regressions↑ (12%), hallucination-rate↑ (from 3.6%->15%), mean-latency per token +7ms (p50 unchanged).
- Quick note: rollout config changed 2026-01-28 (canary -> global). See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-runtime/pull/794

Notes-to-self (raw)
- These are messy; distill later if anything looks reproducible.
- Seed set: seed-1102-compact (attached in run-artifacts but not here).
- Hypothesis A: KV cache bug causes stale prefix when fallback kernels used -> repeats / hallucinated context merge.
- Hypothesis B: quantization variant selection mismatch under long seq -> generation drift on rare tokens.

Ad-hoc rubric (quick, 1-5 where 5 is good)
- Fidelity to prompt facts: 1–5
- Context coherence (threaded): 1–5
- Hallucination severity (lower is better) — invert scale recorded as 5-good (no halluc), 1-bad
- Format preservation (bullets, JSON closing): 1–5
- Token truncation / abrupt stop: 1–5

Sample failures (6 sketches)
1) Case: Incorrect policy cite (hallucinated subsection)
- Prompt (short): "Summarize the refund policy and cite the paragraph numbers."
- v1.9 output: concise summary, cites sections 2.1 / 2.3 (correct).
- v2.1 output: invents "Section 4.7" describing "prorated compensation" (no such text).
- Rubric: Fidelity=1, Coherence=4, Hallucination=1, Format=4, Truncation=5
- Quick thought: generated reference token sequence looks like pattern from other policy doc. Maybe context-window rolled into another doc chunk. KV-cache key collision?

2) Case: Repeated phrase, sudden loop
- Prompt: short Q/A pair (customer asks, system replies).
- v1.9: normal reply ~140 tokens.
- v2.1: repeats sentence "Please contact support" 5x then stops.
- Rubric: Fidelity=3, Coherence=2, Hallucination=5 (none), Format=3, Truncation=2
- Telemetry: p50 token latency spiked for this request (matching fallback kernel use).

3) Case: JSON output corrupted (missing field)
- Prompt: generate JSON with keys {summary, impacts, action_items}.
- v1.9: all present.
- v2.1: missing action_items, adds stray markdown header "## Notes" above JSON.
- Rubric: Fidelity=2, Coherence=2, Hallucination=3, Format=1, Truncation=4
- Suspect: post-processing normalization changed streaming boundary detection -> early flush.

4) Case: Contradictory statements inside single answer
- Prompt: "Is feature X available in region EU?"
- v1.9: "No, planned Q3"
- v2.1: "Yes, available in EU." then later "No, needs opt-in" — contradictory.
- Rubric: Fidelity=1, Coherence=1, Hallucination=2, Format=4, Truncation=5
- Note: joiner token sequence shows sudden change in sampling temperature for last 30 tokens. Check RNG seed alignment and kernel fallback sampling codepath.

5) Case: Token corruption (weird unicode insertion)
- Prompt: medium doc summarization -> result contains "\u25A1\uFFFD" inserted randomly mid sentence.
- v1.9: clean. v2.1: occasional replacement chars in 0.6% samples.
- Rubric: Fidelity=3, Coherence=2, Hallucination=4, Format=2, Truncation=5
- Quick: inspect encoding conversions around kernel handoff. Also check quantization rounding that could map rare token ids -> 0xfffd if mismatch.

6) Case: Length hallucination (creates long irrelevant appendix)
- Prompt: "One-paragraph summary"
- v2.1: 9-paragraph essay, padded with unrelated examples.
- Rubric: Fidelity=1, Coherence=2, Hallucination=1, Format=2, Truncation=4
- Telemetry: request routed to secondary region fallback during peak. Possibly route policy change.

Quick diagnostics done
- Grep-ed sample outputs: pattern shows many failures correlate with fallback kernel flag present in logs (kernel_fallback=true).
- Ran small local reproducer with same prompt and seed -> intermittent reproduction (2/5 runs).
- Re-run with kv-cache disabled (server-side flag) -> failure rate drops to 1.5% vs 12%.
- Attached logs: run-1102-kvtrace (not embedded here).

Immediate next steps (short list)
- [ ] Add focused test that toggles kernel fallback with long-context summarization (create ticket ENG-5099).
- [ ] Push reproducer to PR for instrumentation (include full token traces). Reference PR 794 for hooks.
- [ ] Run regression with quantization profile pinned to v1.9 config to eliminate quantization as confound.
- [ ] Sync with infra (Noah) to check region routing logs for correlated fallback events.
- [ ] Quick rollback canary to v1.9 for one customer cohort if we see customer impact spike.

Hypotheses prioritized (short)
- H1 (priority high): KV cache key/eviction bug interacting with kernel fallback produces stale tokens -> hallucination and repetition. Strong signal: disabling kv-cache reduces failures dramatically.
- H2 (priority med): Kernel fallback path does not maintain RNG seed or sampling params -> contradictions and loops. Evidence: temperature shift observed.
- H3 (priority low): Quantization profile mismatch for long sequences -> token corruption/incorrect id mapping. Evidence weak but nonzero (some replacement chars).

Open questions / notes for follow-up
- Can we add a per-request "kv-checksum" telemetry flag to detect if prefix vs kv matches? (ask serving-runtime)
- How many customer-facing endpoints used v2.1 in canary window vs internal? — need rollout history from product.
- Is there an automated rollback trigger threshold for hallucination rate? Ops runbook unclear.

Scratch hypotheses to test tomorrow (very quick)
- seed-rerun-1102-a: with kernel_fallback=false, kv_cache=true
- seed-rerun-1102-b: kernel_fallback=true, kv_cache=false
- seed-rerun-1102-c: kernel_fallback=true, kv_cache=true, quant-profile=v1.9

Random log excerpt (scrubbed)
- [2026-01-29T03:12:14Z] request-id=rid-9f2a kernel_fallback=true kv_hit=false rng_seed=1102 temp=0.7
- [2026-01-29T03:12:14Z] token-gen: ... "Please contact support" "Please contact support" "Please contact support"

Notes to file: keep one-page summary for pager handoff. If nothing else, add these reproducer seeds to ENG-5099 and wire up a nightly job to run the three reruns above for 72 hours.

Timestamp: 2026-02-27 09:13 (local)
